attempted_claim: Let φ be a fixed even Hecke–Maass cusp form for SL₂(ℤ), and let u_j range over an orthonormal Hecke–Maass basis for SL₂(ℤ), with spectral parameters t_j>0. For every ε>0, does the Lindelöf-on-average estimate Σ_{T<t_j≤T+Δ}|L(1/2, sym²u_j×φ)|² ≪_{φ,ε} T^{1+ε}Δ hold uniformly for T^{1/5+ε}≤Δ≤T^{1−ε}? (A smooth spectral weight supported on this interval may be used, with the corresponding harmonic weights.)
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the target was obtained: all three concrete routes (Kuznetsov-Weil off-diagonal, spectral large sieve, Watson period reduction) were blocked by quantitative barriers, and the bounded exponent model is heuristic rather than a theorem. The session produced no independently valuable original increment; the barrier count is routine bookkeeping and is not claimed as a finding.
